info.title: QuickBooks Online Accounting API
info.description: Intuit's QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3: CRUD, void, PDF and email operations on every documented accounting entity under /v3/company/{realmId}, the SQL-like query endpoint, change data capture, batch, attachment upload, financial reports and entitlements. Entity schemas are converted mechanically from Intuit's own v3 XSDs, so they carry every field up to the latest minor version (pass minorversion to receive the newer ones). The OpenFn intuit adaptor reaches it through generic http.get/http.post on configuration.baseUrl with a Bearer access token.
